s: Pipulate is reborn as a local-first, single-tenant pipeline processing tool using FastHTML/HTMX, emphasizing simple state management via JSON blobs and card-based, resumable processing for SEO workflow automation.
sub: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and callback functions in AI and programming.
Workflow philosophies: development flow state vs. complex tooling, preference for Vim/nvim.
Pipulate's evolution from bookmarklets to Google Sheets, then a UI, and now Jupyter/local server independence.
Local-first development with Nix/Guix for portable, interoperable tech infrastructures.
FastHTML/HTMX/SQLite for simple text-file based complex automations.
